content: Just use a permanent marker. This is way too fidgety,
If you're in the US and you reprint the cheatsheet, you will be wrong. The prusa printed version is A10 paper, not US-standard letter.

Just take a single piece of white filament and cut it at 400mm.  Then put a black mark at 300mm, another at 270, 240 and finally at 210.  Push that filament into the appropriate PTFE tube until the mark shows and adjust the tube length until the end lines up with the tube guide.  Then move on to the next PTFE tube and the next mark.  Works like a charm.
I cut 4 pieces of filament to the lengths, which was slightly easier than using 2 pieces and recutting. But I think there are a lot of even better ideas in these comments.
Would it not be easier to just mark the ptfe tubes with a pen or use tape before putting them in the top holder/guide-thing instead of this cutting-the-wire-task?
